description: This file defines interfaces for stream reliability testing grains in an Orleans-based distributed system, including generic and non-generic versions, as well as an interface for stream unsubscription testing.

classes.name: IStreamReliabilityTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that tests stream reliability, supporting generic and non-generic versions, with methods for managing consumers and producers, and sending items.

classes.name: IStreamUnsubscribeTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that manages stream subscriptions and unsubscriptions.

methods.name: GetReceivedCount
methods.description: Returns the count of received stream items.

methods.name: GetErrorsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of errors encountered.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple method to check grain responsiveness.

methods.name: AddConsumer
methods.description: Adds a consumer to a stream, with generic or non-generic version.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a consumer from a stream, with generic or non-generic version.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Designates the grain as a producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: RemoveProducer
methods.description: Removes the grain's role as a producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: ClearGrain
methods.description: Clears or resets the grain's state.

methods.name: RemoveAllConsumers
methods.description: Removes all consumers from the stream.

methods.name: IsConsumer
methods.description: Checks if the grain is a consumer.

methods.name: IsProducer
methods.description: Checks if the grain is a producer.

methods.name: GetConsumerHandlesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of consumer handles.

methods.name: GetConsumerObserversCount
methods.description: Returns the count of consumer observers.

methods.name: SendItem
methods.description: Sends an item to the stream, generic or non-generic.

methods.name: GetLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the location (SiloAddress) of the grain.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a stream with given streamId and providerName.
